mapper.insert: insert into t_attendance_record (user_id, user_name, real_name, attendance_date, status, check_in_time, remark, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{realName}, #{attendanceDate}, #{status}, #{checkInTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime})

mapper.select: select from t_attendance_record where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and attendance_date = #{date}

select u.id as user_id, u.real_name, u.user_name, max(a.attendance_date) as last_attendance, datediff(curdate(), max(a.attendance_date)) as gap_days from t_user u left join t_attendance_record a on u.id = a.user_id and a.deleted = 0 where u.role = 1 and u.deleted = 0 group by u.id, u.real_name, u.user_name having gap_days > #{days} or last_attendance is null
